title: NFC Rings — NTAG213 Wearable Smart Rings
summary: A passive NTAG213 ring: no battery, no charging, a tap gesture. Sealed in water-resistant epoxy, sized to fit, and ready for door access, gym check-in, smart business cards and tap-to-review programs. Factory-direct with logo engraving from MOQ 50.
heroPoints: Passive and maintenance-free: the ring carries an NTAG213 NFC chip - no battery, no charging, a tap gesture. Sealed in water-resistant epoxy for daily wear.
NTAG 213 inside: 144 bytes of usable NDEF memory (180 bytes total EEPROM), NFC Forum Type 2, fully phone-compatible - verified against our chip registry, not marketing copy.
Sized and branded for your program: US sizes 7-13, laser logo engraving, MOQ 500 with written quotes and lead times.
imageAlt: Black epoxy-sealed NFC smart ring with embedded NTAG213 chip on a wooden surface

brief.label: What it is
items: A passive wearable: an NTAG213 chip and antenna sealed inside a ceramic-epoxy ring body. No battery, nothing to charge, nothing to sync - it behaves exactly like an NFC sticker you cannot lose.
Read range is tap distance (a few centimetres) - by design, for security and battery life of the reader.

brief.label: The chip inside
items: NXP NTAG 213: 144 bytes user NDEF memory (180 bytes total EEPROM), ISO/IEC 14443-A, NFC Forum Type 2 Tag.
NDEF formatting out of the factory for URL, vCard or app-launch payloads - the same data model as our NFC stickers and cards.

brief.label: Build
items: Water-resistant epoxy seal for handwashing, rain and daily wear; not rated for diving - if your program needs that, ask and we will spec it explicitly.
Ring sizes US 7-13; logo engraving or custom NDEF payload pre-written at the factory.

author: Peter Zhang

sections.title: Why programs choose a ring over a card or sticker
sections.intro: A ring is the only NFC form factor your user physically cannot forget. That single property decides most deployments:
bullets: Gyms and studios: check-in is a fist-bump to a reader - no card, no app, no queue at the desk.
Events and venues: VIP identification that stays on the guest through the whole event.
Smart business card and tap-to-review: the ring carries your vCard or Google review link - the same playbook as our NFC cards, worn instead of carried.
Corporate access: badge replacement for staff who never wear lanyards - subject to your reader platform accepting NTAG213.

sections.title: NTAG 213 - what the ring's chip actually delivers

rows: 144 bytes - enough for a URL, contact card or command payload
180 bytes (includes configuration, UID and lock bytes)
None - NTAG213 is not a secure-element chip; for high-security access see our DESFire or NTAG 424 DNA cards

sections.title: Honest fit check
paragraphs: A ring is a convenience wearable carrying the same data as a sticker - it does not add security. If your program needs authenticated taps or anti-cloning, NTAG 424 DNA (with cryptographic per-tap responses) is the right platform, and we will tell you when the ring is the wrong answer: swimming programs, heavy machinery environments, or any site demanding ISO 14443 reader alignment you cannot test in advance. Send your reader model first; we confirm compatibility before you order.

faq.question: Does an NFC ring work with iPhone and Android?
faq.answer: Yes for reading: NTAG213 is an NFC Forum Type 2 tag, and both Android and iPhone (iPhone XS and newer) read it natively - iPhone background-tap opens the URL or profile payload. For door readers, compatibility depends on your reader's configuration, so send us the reader model before ordering.

faq.question: Is the ring waterproof?
faq.answer: The epoxy seal is water-resistant for daily life - handwashing, rain, showers. It is not dive-rated. If your use case involves sustained submersion (swimming programs, pools), tell us and we will specify a suitable construction explicitly rather than overstate this one.

faq.question: How much data fits on the ring?
faq.answer: 144 bytes of usable NDEF memory - a URL, a vCard, a review-link payload or a short command. It is not a data vault; it is a trigger.

faq.question: What is the MOQ and can we get our logo engraved?
faq.answer: MOQ 500 pieces across your size mix. Laser engraving of your logo is available, and we can pre-write the NDEF payload so the rings arrive tap-ready.
